name: Climber's kit

body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 77, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 80 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Category Tools
Description
These crampons, pitons, ropes, and other tools give you a +2 circumstance bonus on Climb checks.
